acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: sealed CPU generator/twin manifest, replay hashes, oracle receipts, no-memory-controller ledger
acceptance_tests.expected: Across at least 50 generator seeds: deterministic prefix replay; hidden-graph oracle A2/A3 value >=0.85; registered Bayes-optimal and frozen 32B no-lifetime-memory controls <=0.35; injected authentic lifetime memory materially improves value; shuffled and twin memory each remove at least half that gain; shortcut probes <=0.35.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: PCFL is a valid constructive experiential-memory instrument or lifetime memory is necessary under its six-action budget.
acceptance_tests.setup: Implement only a hash-bound CPU reference generator, counterfactual twins, target manifest, and registered controls after approval.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: immutable event/proposal/status/provenance fixtures and compiler-admission receipts
acceptance_tests.expected: Accept direct witnessed atoms and valid provenance diamonds; reject cycles, descendant citations, canonical-equivalent mutual support, duplicate-root counting, tainted descendants, terminal-branch descendants, target handles, complete plans, decisive route-tool pairs, and more than one ontology edge per record.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The claimed memory is atomic, provenance-supported, chronologically valid experiential structure rather than answer-bearing or tainted storage.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run fixtures for every semantic lifecycle transition and every positive-corpus admission path.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: checkpoint prefix noninterference diff report and common-deck hashes
acceptance_tests.expected: Changing any post-checkpoint source event, outcome, projection, semantic status, cache, or hidden state leaves all earlier checkpoint artifacts byte-identical. Every arm receives byte-identical source prefixes and cannot mutate them during evaluation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Sleep is prefix-causal or fixed-deck contrasts identify memory representation/use.
acceptance_tests.setup: For 0.5C, 1C, and 2C, replay paired worlds that differ only after the tested checkpoint.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: locked text-only factorial report with fixed-query reads, candidate universe hashes, closure certificates, and per-stage scores
acceptance_tests.expected: Leaked one-query copy arm >=0.95; oracle atoms plus recurrent resolver >=0.85 A2/A3; oracle atoms plus non-adaptive committed queries <=0.35; oracle recurrent valid-proof completion >=0.80; direct-record closure exactly zero. Fixed-query read fidelity, next-query correctness, adaptive dependency rate, proof depth, plan validity, action success, regret, and false-memory use are separately reported.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The environment measures recurrent constructive composition rather than direct copying, generic prompting, or an unmeasured reader/thinking ceiling.
acceptance_tests.setup: Use a frozen common reader and target-independent oracle atoms before any experience-derived corpus or LoRA training.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: formal direct/non-adaptive/interactive closure checker and constructive trace DAG corpus
acceptance_tests.expected: No individual record or one reader return is answer-bearing; non-adaptive query sets remain near floor; successful recurrent A2/A3 traces contain a mechanically valid dependency DAG in which each post-first query introduces a canonical value first read earlier or observed publicly.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A positive A2/A3 action result is constructive memory use rather than stored-solution retrieval.
acceptance_tests.setup: Evaluate atomic memories over fresh-handle A2/A3 targets with the declared four-query/eight-operation limits.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: evaluation timeline traces with public-state hashes, operation records, action receipts, and stage-specific metrics
acceptance_tests.expected: A3 runs as sequential typed environment actions, not an opaque plan commit. Each action receives only current public state, bounded workspace, legal local reads, and prior current-item outcomes. Correct actions lacking a valid dependency trace count as action successes but composition failures; revision is separately scored only when an observed contradiction causes backtracking and later improvement.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Stage credit between reader, resolver, planning, revision, and executed action is auditable.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run A2/A3 sequential-execution fixtures and an A4-ready controlled contradiction fixture without allowing evaluation writes.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: text-condition results, resource ledger, corpus hashes, and paired twin reports
acceptance_tests.expected: E-text exceeds max(R-rec,A-text) by >=0.10; E-text minus S-text is reported with matched outcome shuffling; all named text arms use equal source life, reader protocol, model, context, query, operation, and action budgets.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The supported compiled experiential-text pipeline adds action-relevant structure beyond raw episodic access and the independently organized external-memory baseline at this calibration point.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run L, N, O-open, O-rec, R-rec, A-text, E-text, and S-text before adapter training; freeze the independent A-MEM-style builder before locked worlds.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: same-corpus text/LoRA read report, training manifests, direct-QA corpus manifest, paired twin outcomes, and transport-loss report
acceptance_tests.expected: E-LoRA >= E-text-0.10 with fixed-query read fidelity >=0.90; E-LoRA exceeds max(N,R-rec,A-text,D-LoRA) by >=0.10 in at least four of six locked twin-pairs; E-LoRA minus S-LoRA >=0.15 and each shuffle removes at least half intact gain over N. Failed cells remain failures at the action cap.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The complete compiled experiential-memory-plus-parametric-transport pipeline improves held-out action at the declared calibration ledger, or that transport retains the text corpus's action value.
acceptance_tests.setup: Train only after AT01-AT07 pass; use one predeclared adapter seed only for descriptive locked calibration and retain all artifacts.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: counterfactual goal/query/candidate noninterference report; process capability audit; fresh-process cache/reset report
acceptance_tests.expected: Changing held-out target handles, equivalent goal wording, answer assignment, candidate order, evaluation order, or backend label cannot change source artifacts or introduce target-specific candidate/query information outside the declared public current goal/state. Scorer, hidden truth, audit data, other evaluation items, and sealed outcomes are unreadable and unwritable by cognition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Goal-query laundering, substrate identity leakage, scorer leakage, or cross-item/life contamination.
acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise every model-visible surface: prompts, queries, candidate recognition, reader returns, workspace, repeat state, cache keys, and training inputs.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: signed exact execution bundle: generator/world/target manifests, prompts, schemas, parser, reader, candidate policy, model/tokenizer revisions, generation settings, masks, builders, controls, LoRA recipe, estimator, seeds, failure rules, and resource ledger
acceptance_tests.expected: Every material behavioral choice is content-addressed before implementation. The no-lifetime-memory controllers, independent builder, CPU reference oracle, checkpoint semantics, training seed policy, uncertainty rule, and negative-result language are executable without a post hoc scientific choice.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Exact scope is ratifiable or promotion thresholds are immune to unbound implementation choices.
acceptance_tests.setup: Produce the bundle as a new proposed change, obtain two fresh interpretations, adversarial critique, adjudicated consensus, and a new human-bound approval.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: confirmation preregistration, locked 12-or-16-pair manifests, paired-bootstrap and sign-flip outputs, all-world plots
acceptance_tests.expected: At the first checkpoint beyond native-long-context maximum, E-LoRA-D-LoRA and E-LoRA-A-text each have mean improvement >=0.10 with corrected paired 95% lower confidence bounds >0; same-corpus transport satisfies the preregistered -0.10 non-inferiority margin. Twin-pair is the clustering/randomization unit; adapter seeds are averaged within world, not treated as replicates.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A paper-eligible fixed-deck constructive-memory/transport claim at post-context scale.
acceptance_tests.setup: Only after calibration promotion; use 12 new twin-pairs, expanding to 16 only under the preregistered calibration-variance rule.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: independent reviewer verdict and author-side scientific-advocate response bound to the exact execution bundle and pre-GPU artifacts
acceptance_tests.expected: Independent review verifies all pre-GPU tests, visibility contract, claim boundaries, and artifact integrity. Any repair receives a new review and new bound approval; advocate explanation cannot override rejection.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Authorization for GPU science or headline claims without an independent-review gate.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run after implementation and CPU gates, before any GPU model/adaptor science run.

claims.after: A passed confirmation may support a controlled systems claim that supported experiential structure transported into a per-life LoRA retains near-text action value and exceeds direct-QA LoRA and independent organized text memory at preregistered post-context checkpoints.

loops.rationale: Preserves recurrent local connection growth without making dreaming a one-shot solution generator.

loops.stop_condition: Checkpoint corpus is sealed after finite proposal/view/training budgets; terminal-boundary unsupported claims remain provisional.

summary: PCFL replaces the developmental-kernel pilot as the proposed first calibration: a fixed-deck, counterfactual-twin assay of whether chronologically supported local experiential structure can be recurrently retrieved and composed into novel A2/A3 action, and whether identical compiled text retains that action value after per-life LoRA transport. It preserves the broader action-to-dream-to-memory-to-action thesis while withholding on-policy flywheel, learned-policy, autonomous-discovery, cadence, external-validity, and broad-intelligence claims.
system_thesis: The organism, not any one organ, is the proposed intelligence loop: lived action/outcome episodes supply public evidence; DREAM recurrently proposes local causal connections and preserves provenance; SLEEP compiles only chronologically supported structure; per-life psi_l transports a bounded memory approximation; frozen THINK retrieves local dependencies, composes a provisional plan, acts, observes, and revises; later policy-selected outcomes may only in a later approved stage improve future dream cycles. The LoRA is a lossy transport substrate, not a discoverer or literal graph; a successful action is credited to the complete memory-reader-resolver-environment organism after stage-specific audits.
title: PCFL constructive experiential-memory assay v1
